identificationModule.briefTitle: The Effect of Colchicine on Inflammation in ACS Patients
identificationModule.officialTitle: The Effect of Colchicine on Inflammation in Acute Coronary Syndrome Patients

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study will evaluate whether the anti-inflammatory effect of colchicine is beneficial in ACS patients
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This study will evaluate the effect of colchicine on inflammation, cardiac remodeling, and atherosclerotic risk in STEMI patients through the assessment of the IL-1β, sST2, and lipid profile parameters as well as to examine the drug safety and tolerability in these patients.

maskingInfo.maskingDescription: Electrocardiography parameters assessors and clinical laboratory technicians were masked to the study patient group allocation

armGroups.label: Colchicine group
armGroups.description: Colchicine group, Colchicine oral tablets, loading dose 1mg every 12 hrs for 1 day, followed by 0.5 mg BID for 3 months

armGroups.label: STEMI standard treatment group
armGroups.description: Control group, STEMI standard treatment only

interventions.name: Colchicine Tablets
interventions.description: Colchicine oral tablets loading dose of 1mg every 12 hrs for 1 day, followed by 0.5 mg BID for 3 months

primaryOutcomes.measure: Effect of colchicine therapy on sST2 levels in ACS patients
primaryOutcomes.description: sST2 level in pg/ml is measured using ELISA method before PCI and after 3 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Effect of colchicine therapy on occurrence of ischemic events in ACS patients
secondaryOutcomes.description: Effect of colchicine on the occurrence of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) during the study period

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in left ventricular ejection fraction
secondaryOutcomes.description: Effect of colchicine therapy on left ventricular ejection fraction percentage (%)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in serum levels of IL-1beta
secondaryOutcomes.description: Effect of colchicine therapy on the change in IL-1beta serum levels in pg/L

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Lipid profile parameters and TG/HDL-C ratio
secondaryOutcomes.description: Effect of colchicine therapy on the change in lipid profile parameters and TG/HDL-C ratio

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* male or female
* \>18 yrs
* STEMI patients who were successfully treated with PCI.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or breast-feeding women or women of childbearing potential.
* Active inflammatory, known malignancy, infectious diseases or current treatment with corticosteroids or anti inflammatory agents.
* Known hypersensitivity to colchicine or current chronic treatment with colchicine.
* Severe renal failure (estimated creatinine clearance \<30ml/min) or hepatic failure (Child Pugh score B or C )
* Cardiac arrest, ventricular fibrillation, cardiogenic shock or previous myocardial infarction.
* Patients using the following agents: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (ritonavir, clarithromycin, ketoconazole, voriconazole, itraconazole), intermediate CYP3A4 inhibitors (aprepitant, diltiazem, erythromycin, fluconazole, verapamil), P-gp inhibitor (amiodarone, clarithromycin, erythromycin, azithromycin, ranolazine, verapamil, ketoconazole, itraconazole) and grape fruit juice
